rows.text: 吉田忠智's address dated 24 February 2018 is given as the party leader's address; he closes it as the 党首あいさつ.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: 吉田忠智 recalls that on 1 November 2013 he took over from 福島みずほ前党首 and has served as leader for four years and four months.

locator.paragraph: the paragraph beginning 私は、２０１３年１１月１日に

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: 吉田忠智 says that after the party failed to gain seats in the last general election he felt he had to take responsibility, that a leader without a Diet seat faced many constraints, and that 又市幹事長 had agreed to succeed him (又市次期党首).
